1	# Instruction preparation
2	
3	Preparation has one outcome: all applicable instruction bytes have returned
4	before subject investigation. The helper packages existing files and checks
5	membership; it neither detects profiles nor grants permission to investigate.
6	Read-only isolated agents continue to use the direct source paths supplied by
7	their parent.
8	
9	1. Execute the helper path supplied by SKILL.md with argument `bootstrap`.
10	   Read **every** returned part, in order, through its `END PACKET PART` marker.
11	   Request the remaining lines if a Read is truncated. These parts contain the
12	   full process, shared protocols, common method and every Known-profile
13	   detection file. Source headers give original paths for relative links.
14	2. Select the Git diff from filenames/metadata under the loaded process. Task
15	   documents and requirements are investigated only after checklist loading;
16	   their discovery does not open the preparation gate. Apply the
17	   loaded detection rules, preserving each match/non-match/ENOENT outcome.
18	   For active profiles, run `profiles --profile NAME` (repeat `--profile` as
19	   needed), then Read all returned parts to load their indexes. Resolve their
20	   conditionals using only the allowed bounded predicate inspection.
21	3. Run `checklists` with each active `--profile NAME`, a `--load
22	   NAME/checklist.md` for every selected entry, and a `--skip
23	   'NAME/checklist.md=concrete unmatched predicate'` for each unselected
24	   conditional. Select undecidable conditionals conservatively. The helper
25	   rejects incomplete index coverage, unknown entries and skipped always-load
26	   files. It does not verify the truth of your predicate decisions.
27	4. Read every checklist-packet part fully. Emit one compact preparation
28	   checkpoint: selected diff, detection outcomes, selected checklist sources,
29	   and completed packet parts. Only completed returned text counts. Then enter
30	   the process's investigation phase.
31	
32	For no active profiles, record that result and no selected checklists; the
33	common instructions still apply. Packet creation and hashes establish packaging,
34	not reading or behavioral compliance. Use tool results to establish ordering.
35	Keep packet files available through the review/evidence capture; they contain
36	no reviewed source and live in newly allocated temporary directories.
37	
38	**Direct-read fallback:** if Python/helper execution is unavailable or the
39	helper cannot package an instruction/index faithfully, retain that limitation and read the
40	process and its shared/common instructions, every Known-profile detection file,
41	active indexes and every selected checklist directly. Use the same scope,
42	predicate and completion rules. A valid complete packet Read supplies the
43	original source contents for those reads; do not reread identical files merely
44	because they arrived together. Missing required instructions still block
45	investigation, with only the shared detection procedure's defined fallbacks.
46
